title: Create hermes-agent app
description: Create apps/hermes-agent/ with config.json, docker-compose.yml (gateway + dashboard, Docker socket mount, hermes-net), metadata/description.md, metadata/logo.jpg. Use schema_version 2. Dashboard is is_main on port 9119. Gateway internal on 8642.
close_reason: hermes-agent app created with all required files

title: Run tests and push
description: Run bun test, fix any failures (especially categories field in config.json - use valid runtipi category). Then jj describe + jj git push --remote runtipi-store --bookmark main.
close_reason: tests pass, committed and pushed to GitHub

title: Remove uptime-kuma app
description: Delete apps/uptime-kuma/ directory entirely. Update README.md to remove the uptime-kuma entry from the apps list.

title: Create uptime-kuma app definition
description: Create apps/uptime-kuma/ with config.json (schema v2), docker-compose.yml (x-runtipi schema_version 2), metadata/description.md. Download logo.jpg from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runtipi/runtipi-appstore/master/apps/uptime-kuma/metadata/logo.jpg
close_reason: uptime-kuma app created with all required files including logo

title: Install deps and run tests
description: Run bun install in repo root, then bun test to verify all apps pass validation. Fix any failures.

title: Create whoami app definition
description: Create apps/whoami/ with config.json, docker-compose.yml, metadata/description.md (copy from template). Download logo.jpg from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runtipi/example-appstore/main/apps/whoami/metadata/logo.jpg
close_reason: whoami app created with all required files including logo

title: Scaffold template files
description: Copy all non-binary template files from example-appstore into repo. Includes: package.json, tsconfig.json, renovate.json, config.js, LICENSE, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/renovate.yml, scripts/update-config.ts. Also: merge node_modules into .gitignore, fix __tests__/apps.test.ts (change docker-compose.json to docker-compose.yml), create .agents/merged-files.md documenting the .gitignore merge and test fix.

title: Add Honcho memory engine to Tipi store
description: Create a Tipi/Runtipi store app item for Honcho (plastic-labs/honcho) — the self-hosted LLM memory engine. Includes Dockerfile that builds from source, docker-compose.yml, config, init.sql, env example, and documentation.

title: Update project docs with build/test commands
description: Update CLAUDE.md Build & Test section. Update .github/copilot-instructions.md with app structure format and bun test command. Update README.md to describe the store purpose.
close_reason: Docs updated with app structure, build/test commands
